title: The Buffer() constructor is deprecated
summary: Node.js deprecates calling Buffer() or new Buffer() in application code (DEP0005): documentation-only since v6.0.0, runtime warning since v10.0.0.

constraints: Keep the behavior of the call unchanged; check the replacement's argument and error handling differences.

steps.title: Replace the Buffer constructor
steps.instructions: Use Buffer.from for existing data, Buffer.alloc for zero-filled memory, and Buffer.allocUnsafe only when the content is overwritten immediately.

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
